question: Identify the odd option in relation to the oceanic layers.
solution:
The Correct Answer is **The Oceanic Slope.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Scientists have divided the ocean into **five main layers**. These layers, known as "zones", extend from the surface to the most extreme depths.

 
 
• **Epipelagic Zone** - It extends from the surface to 200 meters (656 feet).
 
• **Mesopelagic Zone** - Below the epipelagic zone is the mesopelagic zone, extending from 200 meters (656 feet) to 1,000 meters (3,281 feet).
 
• **Bathypelagic Zone** - This zone extends from 1,000 meters (3,281 feet) down to 4,000 meters (13,124 feet).
 
• **Abyssopelagic Zone** - It extends from 4,000 meters (13,124 feet) to 6,000 meters (19,686 feet).
 
• **Hadalpelagic Zone** - This layer extends from 6,000 meters (19,686 feet) to the bottom of the deepest parts of the ocean.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b64361ee292c0fcd7b63724865a9a9859546faee709aa5e4f599110edd4bb52f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The ocean deeps** are the deepest part of the ocean. They are long, narrow, steep-sided and flat-floored depressions on the ocean floor.
 
• A **continental shelf **is a portion of a continent that is submerged under an area of relatively shallow water known as a shelf sea. 
 
• The continuously sloping portion of the continental margin, seaward of the continental shelf and extending down to the deep sea floor of the abyssal plain, is known as** the continental slope**. It is characterised by gradients of 2.5 degrees. It extends between the depth of 180 to 3600 metres.
